projects.name: Deltadesh

projects.name: Concept sites for Dhaka businesses

projects.name: Dhaka Utilities Map
projects.tagline: Interactive city map of Dhaka with 13 color-coded utility layers — hospitals, schools, parks, police, mosques and more.

projects.name: Deltadutch

projects.name: Build Strong
projects.tagline: Multi-page site for a Bangladesh construction, interiors and waterproofing company: materials catalogue with filters, project pages and a waterproofing cost estimator.

projects.name: Stackframe
projects.tagline: Study site for a university web-technologies exam. HTML, CSS, JS, PHP and MySQL lessons where the code actually runs in the browser.

projects.name: SkillBank
projects.tagline: Skill-exchange web app with credits, matches and session booking. PHP MVC, prepared statements, CSRF protection, and a 40-case Selenium test suite.

projects.name: GentleBudget

projects.name: Corner Table

projects.name: Codex Tools

projects.name: LinguaBot
projects.tagline: Embeddable multilingual chat widget — English, Bangla, Hindi, Urdu. Drop-in script tag.

projects.name: DocAtHome
projects.tagline: Role-based home-healthcare management system. Four user roles, 18 forms, full booking and payment flow.

faq.a: HTML, CSS and JavaScript; PHP with MySQL; Python; Leaflet for maps. I build with Claude Code: I scope the job, direct and review the code, test it in the browser, and deploy it. A few projects here were built with React, Next.js or FastAPI; I list those as built-with, not as specialties.
Yes, always. Send yours or use my mutual NDA template (./assets/nda-mutual.md) — both sides can mark it up. I sign before the first call if your project is sensitive.
You do. From day one. Repo transferred to your org on kickoff. No licensing tricks, no "perpetual usage rights" — it's yours.
Both. Small, clear scope: fixed price. Open-ended work: hourly. I'll tell you which fits after a short call.

faq.q: Do you work with my designer / PM / existing team?
faq.a: Yes. I integrate into whatever you've got — Figma handoffs, Linear tickets, Slack, async standups. I'm not precious about process.

faq.q: Time zone overlap with US / EU?
faq.a: I keep 10:00–18:00 BST hours, which overlaps EU mornings and US East Coast late evenings. Weekly sync at a time that works for you.
No middlemen, no agency overhead, no telephone-game of requirements. You talk to the person building it.
